sections.label: Order Paper question limits
sections.summary: After omitted PQs are listed on the Order Paper for the next Sitting on or after 13 March 2024, the usual five-question limit under Standing Order 20(3) applies to subsequent Sittings.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: For avoidance of doubt, I should clarify that after the omitted PQs are listed on the Order Paper for the next available Sitting, on or after 13 March 2024, the usual limit of five questions on the Order Paper will apply as per Standing Order 20(3) for any subsequent Sittings.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Ms Poa should take this into account, should she wish to postpone any of her questions on the Order Paper for the next available Sitting to a later Sitting date.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I understand that the Parliament Secretariat has taken steps to tighten the IT system and strengthen the processes for the receipt of questions.
